notes: The verse note Or, compasseth them about concerns חֹדֶרֶת and does not change the alignment.
Two judgment calls are recorded in unit notes: the placement of the chain's of on חָלָל, and the added thy before hands.

Both calls survive review. חָלָל is the morphological rectum of חֶרֶב, so rule 19 puts the chain's *of* there even though the ASV's reordering sets *the great one* between them (rule 25). s015 is tagged Sh, not Sd, so rule 32's first sentence governs and it is unrepresented. אֶל־כָּף correctly fuses to *together* under rule 30, headed on the noun.
